lessons.title: 20. Dispatch Tool
lessons.solution_code:
def dispatch(name, args, registry):
    return registry[name](**args)

tests.name: test_dispatch

lessons.title: 21. Validate Arguments
lessons.description: Implement `validate_args(args, required)` raising ValueError if any required key missing.

tests.name: test_validate_args
tests.unittest_code:
def test_validate_args(self):
    self.assertEqual(validate_args({'a': 1}, ['a']), {'a': 1})
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        validate_args({}, ['a'])

lessons.title: 22. Tool Result Message (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `tool_result_message(call_id, content)` returning a tool role message dict.
lessons.solution_code:
def tool_result_message(call_id, content):
    return {'role': 'tool', 'tool_call_id': call_id, 'content': content}

tests.name: test_tool_result_message
tests.unittest_code:
def test_tool_result_message(self):
    m = tool_result_message('c1', 'ok')
    self.assertEqual(m['role'], 'tool')
    self.assertEqual(m['tool_call_id'], 'c1')
